name: Gopeed
description: Gopeed is a fast download manager for HTTP(S), BitTorrent, Magnet links and ed2k, written in Go and Flutter. It supports JavaScript extensions, a REST API, webhooks, post-download scripts and browser integration.

notes.text: The login password is generated during the install and stored in /opt/gopeed_data/config.json. Run systemctl restart gopeed after changing it.
Keep /opt/gopeed_data/config.json valid JSON. If Gopeed cannot parse it, it starts without any login on an empty database.
The REST API and the browser extension's remote mode use the apiToken from the same file, sent as the X-Api-Token header.
